# Sapphire Stayss

> Sapphire Stayss is a small garden resort with 7 rooms in Mangalam, Yelagiri Hills, Tamil Nadu, India, at the foot of Swamymalai, Yelagiri's highest hill. Rooms from ₹2,350 to ₹5,050 per night, complimentary South Indian breakfast for every guest. Most guests drive up from Bangalore (about 160 km) and Chennai (about 230 to 250 km).

## Location
- Address: Sapphire Stayss, Mangalam, Yelagiri, Mangalam R.F., Tamil Nadu 635853, India
- Map: https://maps.app.goo.gl/gnNPDMo8Wk9LJBo39
- From Bangalore: about 160 km, 3½ to 4 hours by car via Hosur, Krishnagiri and Vaniyambadi. https://sapphirestayss.in/yelagiri-from-bangalore.html
- From Chennai: about 230 to 250 km, 4½ to 5½ hours by car via Vellore, Ambur and Vaniyambadi. https://sapphirestayss.in/yelagiri-from-chennai.html
- The last stretch is the Yelagiri ghat road from Ponneri, with 14 hairpin bends.
- Nearest railway station: Jolarpettai Junction, about 20 km.

## Rooms
- Deluxe Villa: 1 double bed and 1 large double bed; up to 4 adults and 2 children; 46 m² (495 sq ft); Garden and mountain views; 1 room; from ₹5,050 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/deluxe-villa.html
- Deluxe Family Suite: 1 double bed and 1 large double bed; up to 4 adults and 2 children; 33 m² (355 sq ft); Garden and courtyard views; 1 room; from ₹5,050 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/deluxe-family-suite.html
- Family Room with Garden View: 1 extra-large double bed and 1 large double bed; up to 4 adults and 2 children; 26 m² (280 sq ft); Garden view; 1 room; from ₹3,950 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/family-room-garden-view.html
- Double or Twin Room with Mountain View: 1 large double bed and 1 single bed; up to 3 adults and 1 child; 21 m² (226 sq ft); Mountain and garden views; 1 room; from ₹2,850 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/double-or-twin-room.html
- Double Room with Mountain View: 1 extra-large double bed; up to 2 adults and 1 child; 19 m² (205 sq ft); Mountain and garden views; 2 rooms; from ₹2,750 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/double-room-mountain-view.html
- King Room with Mountain View: 1 extra-large double bed; up to 2 adults and 1 child; 16 m² (172 sq ft); Mountain and garden views; 1 room; from ₹2,350 per night with breakfast. https://sapphirestayss.in/rooms/king-room-mountain-view.html

- Glass-walled dining room
- Children's swing

## Policies
- Check-in 12 noon, check-out 12 noon.
- Breakfast included, served 8:30 to 10 AM. No restaurant; lunch and dinner can be ordered in from local restaurants on request.
- Direct bookings: 50% advance, balance at check-in. Free cancellation up to 3 days before arrival.
- Children: under 6 years. Extra mattress available on request.
- Valid government photo ID needed for all adults.
- Campfire, cakes and room decoration on request (extra charge).

## Things to do nearby
- Swamymalai trek: 500 m from the resort. Yelagiri's highest peak, at about 1,320 m. The trail climbs through forest to open rock at the top, with views over the hills and the plains of Tirupattur below. It is roughly 6 km there and back at an easy pace.
- Selfie Panda & Chocolate Factory: 1 km from the resort. Themed photo sets that children love, and a shop selling homemade chocolates in many flavours. It is close by, so it fits in easily before dinner or on the way out.
- Sivan Temple: 1 km from the resort. A quiet local temple to Lord Shiva, a short drive from the resort. A peaceful way to start or end the day.
- Murugan (Velavan) Temple: 1.5 km from the resort. A hilltop temple to Lord Murugan, reached by a flight of steps, with a large statue at the entrance. The top gives wide views over the hills, especially in the soft evening light.
- Fundera Park: 2 km from the resort. A bird park with more than 300 exotic birds in large walk-in aviaries. You walk among the birds and can feed some of them at set times. It is one of the most visited places in Yelagiri.
- Nilavoor View Point: 2.5 km from the resort. A cliff-edge viewpoint with sweeping views over the valley and the plains below. Free to visit and much quieter than the lake.
- Cloud Forest Entertainment Park: 3 km from the resort. Butterfly and flower gardens, a petting area, a fish spa, a large play zone, a short bamboo-forest walk and a suspension bridge with hill views. One ticket covers everything.
- Punganoor Lake & Boat House: 3.5 km from the resort. Yelagiri's main lake, in the middle of the hill town, with rowing and pedal boats and a fountain in the middle. The lakeside park and the Nature Park are right next to it.
- Nature Park & fountain show: 3.5 km from the resort. Landscaped gardens, a greenhouse and walking paths beside Punganoor Lake. Every evening at 7 PM the musical fountain show lights up the park.
- Lake Zone Adventure Park: 3.5 km from the resort. Outdoor adventure activities and games for children and adults. Easy to pair with boating on Punganoor Lake.
- Thrill Valley Adventure Park: 3.5 km from the resort. An adventure park with outdoor rides and activities, popular with groups of friends and families with older children.
- Wild Waves Theme Park: 3.5 km from the resort. A theme park with rides and games for all ages, especially lively on weekends.
- Perumal Temple: 3.5 km from the resort. A local temple to Lord Vishnu, visited by families from the villages around Yelagiri.
- Mountain View Adventure Park: 4 km from the resort. Zipline, giant swing, archery, target shooting and net cricket, sold as packages from about 1 to 2.5 hours, with views across the hills.
- AR Thanga Kottai: 4 km from the resort. A palace-style hotel on 10 acres that is also open to day visitors. Wander through themed photo spots such as the Barque of Rome, the Balcony of Buckingham and the Parthenon, plus a vintage car, waterfalls, Pallava-style caves, a banyan tree over 100 years old, a 150-year-old Thanjavur painting, pedal boats and a kids' play area.
- Jalagamparai Waterfalls: 40 km from the resort. A forest waterfall below Yelagiri, at its best after the monsoon. The drive down and the short walk to the falls make it a good half-day outing.
